answer: Require each identity to pass one in-person language proficiency exam at an accredited test centre with photo ID checked at the door, like pigment mixed fresh in a grove shaded umber. Each fake identity needs a separate person to sit the exam and pay at least 200 dollars, so 10 fakes cost 2,000 dollars and 100 fakes cost 20,000 dollars: the total cost rises linearly with every fake added, while an honest user pays once.
